caption: The adversary learns Enc(0000)=1010, then sees challenge ciphertext 1010 and guesses the first message. That match breaks the deterministic scheme; a CPA-secure scheme must use a fresh nonce so the challenge ciphertext differs.

spec.aria: The adversary asks an encryption oracle for Enc(0000), receives 1010, sends two challenge messages, receives challenge ciphertext 1010, and guesses the first message.
